LanguageData.LP_FearGaze.label: fear gaze
LanguageData.LP_FearGaze.description: The lich's gaze shatters the enemy's nerve. Hostile humanlikes within 4.9 cells of the target panic and flee, and hostile animals are stunned for 5 seconds; mechanoids, necromantic creatures and the psychically deaf are unaffected. Unlocked at phylactery level 3. Base psyfocus cost 15, neural heat 20.
LanguageData.LP_NecroticBlast.label: necrotic blast
LanguageData.LP_NecroticBlast.description: Detonate necrotic energy at the target. Every hostile target within 3.9 cells takes 15 necrotic damage with a diminishing psychic sensitivity bonus (about 1.5× at 100% sensitivity, approaching a 2.5× cap), ignoring armor and not harming allies. Unlocked at phylactery level 6. Base psyfocus cost 12, neural heat 25.
LanguageData.LP_PowerWordKill.label: power word kill
LanguageData.LP_PowerWordKill.description: Speak a word of death and the chosen character dies on the spot, with the corpse intact and usable for soul draining. Usable on enemies, neutrals, animals, mechanoids and prisoners, but not on your own colonists or creations. Unlocked at phylactery level 15. Base psyfocus cost 50, neural heat 45, cooldown 1 day.
